content: Governance/agent-docs surface (README, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, CHANGELOG, CODEOWNERS, CONTRIBUTING, SECURITY, RUNBOOK, docs/architecture.mmd, .claude/commands/{release,pr-reviews,issue-reviews,prioritize}) mirrors warren/seeds and the templates/l5-toolkit/docs templates.
